name: 20 Twenty
notes: Popmenu site (popmenu-version header confirmed) but this deployment server-renders the FULL schema.org Menu JSON-LD for every tab, not just the usual 3-item popular sample - verified across all 8 menus (Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, Bar Drinks, Dessert, Kids Menu) fetched individually at /menus/<slug>?location=carlsbad. 180 raw priced+unpriced item entries, 173 priced, 152 unique after removing exact name+price duplicates shared across menus (e.g. Pacific Prawn Cocktail appears on Lunch/Dinner/Happy Hour For the Table sections; Avocado Toast on both Breakfast and Brunch). Dropped 7 items with no price field at all (Carlsbad Acai Bowl, Pina Colada Granola x2, Chef Coastal Board x3, Greek Yogurt-adjacent items) - these are unpriced on the site itself (board/bowl priced by size, not stated). Section field records which menu(s) the dish appeared under.

name: Whiskers and Wine Bar
notes: Restaurant's own Squarespace site, fully server-rendered plain HTML (no JS needed). Address on the page footer (2856 Adams Ave. San Diego, CA 92116) matches the work list exactly. All 7 sections present and priced: Starters, Flatbreads, Oven Roasted Sandwiches, Specialty Cocktails, Wine, Beer & Ciders, Non-Alcoholic Beverages - this is a cat-cafe/wine-bar concept so food is a small side menu (boards, flatbreads, sandwiches) alongside the cocktail/wine/beer list, which matches what the site itself presents as the whole menu. Dropped 3 unpriced entries that are notes, not dishes: "Gluten Free Options Available", the "PREMIUM FLIGHTS" section sub-header, and "Ask About Our Delicious, Seasonal, Kombucha, Seltzer, & Hard Cider Flavors".
